programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: THE WAWIES (2025)
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Eva Braun
programme.desc: Fue solo después de su muerte que Eva Braun saltó a la fama en Alemania. Junto con Adolf Hitler, el 30 de abril de 1945 se quitó la vida en el búnker bajo la Cancillería del Reich en Berlín. El día anterior, el dictador se había casado con Braun, su amante durante muchos años. Apartada del mundo, Eva Braun pasó la mayor parte del tiempo en Múnich o en la residencia Berghof de Hitler en los Alpes. Después de la guerra, Albert Speer, antiguo arquitecto de Adolf Hitler, describió a Braun como una de las "decepciones de la historia". La primera biografía científica de Heike Görtmaker busca revisar la imagen de la rubia y apolítica figura al lado del Führer.

programme.title: La Orden Judicial: La Ley de Breaker (2025)
programme.desc: Un simple intercambio de prisioneros lleva al alguacil Breaker a luchar contra un grupo de bandidos por el destino de un pequeño pueblo.

programme.title: La Cacería: En el fin del mundo
programme.sub-title: La Caceria: En el fin del mundo - Episodio 01
programme.desc: La pesadilla comienza cuando José Mirkovic, un adolescente solitario y alumno de un colegio de curas, desaparece tras una noche de fiesta. Ante la indiferencia policial y el silencio de la Iglesia, su madre, Susana Rivera, inicia una cruzada para descubrir la verdad. Tras semanas sin respuestas, aparece un extraño que ofrece esperanza: César Rojas, ex policía convertido en investigador privado, marcado por un pasado turbulento. Junto a la joven oficial Antonia Loij, Rojas sigue el rastro del enigmático padre Correa, ex director del colegio de José, quien parece esconder más de un secreto. Mientras Susana y Rojas luchan por resolver el caso y descubrir qué le sucedió a José, en Santiago el capitán Rodrigo Carrasco, antiguo compañero de Rojas en la policía, recibe una alerta sobre el caso. En las sombras, una red de encubrimientos comienza a cerrarse, mientras crece el temor de que este y otros crímenes enterrados salgan a la luz.

programme.title: Poco Más de Un Año (2024)

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Finalmente, los enemigos de Ortega encuentran a la esposa y a la hija, sin embargo, las mujeres son rescatadas por la Policía. Reina y Eduardo logran encontrar esmeraldas en la veta vieja, esto preocupa a Alejandro, pues teme por el bienestar de su hijo.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Ortega despide a todos sus empleados de la mina, pues cree que lo quieren traicionar. Al mismo tiempo, Olga conoce a Javier Arango, el nuevo Cura del pueblo, del cual queda completamente enamorada.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: En el pueblo La Victoria, se libera una gran batalla cuando Jacinto, cegado por la venganza tras la muerte de su hijo, se enfrenta a Ortega, allí campesinos obligados por el esmeraldero a tomar las armas para defenderlo, son asesinados. Al mismo tiempo, Eduardo encuentra la tan anhelada Titiguaca, poniéndolo en el ojo del huracán.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Rubén, el hijo de la empleada de los Guerrero, quiere vengar la muerte de su padre, por otra parte, le tiende una trampa a Jacinto en la cual es asesinado entre Emilio y Ortega. Mientras tanto, el Ejército planea tomarse las minas tras la guerra que se ha desatado.

programme.title: Esmeraldas

programme.title: Esmeraldas

programme.title: Esmeraldas

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting. From the pressure of national competition to the routines that build confidence, they reveal how preparation, mental focus, and years of dedication lead to success. The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells. - As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

programme.sub-title: Mi hijo dijo que lo golpeaste

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: Pamela quiere pesar 40 libras. Samantha, que sufre de bulimia y alcoholismo, roba para consumir sus atracones. ¿Pueden las dos mujeres lidiar con sus desórdenes alimenticios con apoyo y tratamiento?

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.sub-title: Ella vendió a su bebé por $23
programme.desc: Kandie era la tutora del hijo de Katie, quien falleció con tan solo 9 meses. Katie cree que Kandie tuvo algo que ver con su muerte, pero Kandie afirma que lo quería más que Katie e incluso la acusa de vendérselo por 23 dólares.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Harta del maltrato en su relación, Carla le dice a su novio que es infiel con su compañero de cuarto. Luego, Jay quiere decirle a Nikki que ella se acostó con su amante Crystal.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Hope ha venido a enfrentarse a su mejor amiga, Laura, por robarle a su novio, Joey, y luego comprometerse con él. A continuación, John dirá que no tiene la culpa por acostarse con la mejor amiga de su novia.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Destiny confronta a su amiga por invadir la propiedad de otras personas; una confesión de proporciones épicas podría ser un factor decisivo; un secreto oculto puede alterar los planes de una pareja.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: El marido de Darleen dice que es adicto a los clubes de striptease; el novio de Mary está obsesionado con limpiar su coche, y ella sospecha que lo está usando como tapadera para algo más; el miedo de Jesse al compromiso lo mete en problemas.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.sub-title: ¡No te vas a casar con él!
programme.desc: ¡Amigos y familiares se niegan a aceptar el matrimonio entre personas del mismo sexo! Martin no quiere que su hijo se case con su novio. April quiere recuperar a su ex, ¡pero está enamorado de un hombre! ¿Quién tiene la última palabra?

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.sub-title: El Crimen De Maria Mercedes Gnecco Parte Ii
programme.desc: El juicio por el asesinato de María Mercedes Gnecco se ha convertido en un caso de gran controversia. La Fiscalía acusa a su esposo, de montar una escena para ocultar su culpabilidad. La investigación revela posibles motivos económicos.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Cuando dos granjeros conocidos desaparecen, la policía rastrea un teléfono para encontrar al sospechoso.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Daniela Castaño, de 19 años, fue brutalmente asesinada en La Estrella, Antioquia, en enero de 2020. Su asesina, Valentina García, recibió solo 10 años de cárcel tras un polémico preacuerdo con la Fiscalía, lo que indignó a su familia y expertos legales.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Edgar Vallejo, desaparecido en diciembre de 2022, dejó una carta de advertencia a su hija, revelando que saldría con su hermano José Miguel. Tras investigaciones, se descubrió su trágico paradero, el motivo, sus bienes inmuebles y su dinero.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En Cajicá, Marta Ávila dejó de pagar arriendo y se negó a desalojar la casa de Stefan y Ana Gonzenbach. En Montería, la finca de Adriana Gómez fue invadida por familias tras ser desalojada por paramilitares. En Armenia, Weimar González invadió los lotes de Edgar Vélez y Juan Diego Zapata.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.sub-title: Delitos a causa de la falta de regulación de líneas telefónicas y SIM Card en Colombia
programme.desc: En Colombia, la compra de SIM Cards prepago sin cédula facilita delitos como extorsión y robo de celulares. Miller Steven Falla fue asesinado por su celular, mostrando la gravedad del problema. Expertos y autoridades piden registro obligatorio para reducir estos crímenes.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En las sombras de las cárceles colombianas, las visitas conyugales se convierten en escenarios de horror. Reclusos peligrosos, aprovechando fallas en la seguridad, transforman momentos íntimos en tragedias.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Luz Stella García fue asesinada por su esposo Luis Antonio Quilcue tras años de celos y violencia. Él alegó defensa propia y recibió una condena reducida de 5 años y 4 meses, pese a evidencia de premeditación.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2008, Marco Iván Parrado, un menor de edad, desapareció en Arbeláez, Cundinamarca. Aunque se sospechó de un rapto por las FARC, un celular reveló su cuerpo abandonado en la selva. Las evidencias llevaron a Juan Carlos Mayorga, vigilante del pueblo con antecedentes de pedofilia, como el principal sospechoso del crimen.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Guarne, Antioquia, Jaime Iván Martínez fue capturado por el homicidio de su esposa María Gladis Arango, su amiga Natalia García, y sus dos hijos de 5 y 8 años, ahorcados en 2015. El "Monstruo de Guarne" confesó los crímenes, motivados por el rechazo de su esposa al querer terminar la relación. Fue condenado a 42 años de prisión tras un acuerdo entre la fiscalía y su defensa.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2007, en Mistrató, Risaralda, fueron hallados los cuerpos incinerados de María del Carmen Arango y su hija María Camila en un cafetal. Un negativo fotográfico intacto reveló al culpable: el sacerdote José Franceis Díaz Toro, esposo y padre de las víctimas, quien las asesinó para ocultar su doble vida y proteger su carrera evangelizadora. Fue condenado a 45 años y 10 meses de cárcel. Su cómplice, el sepulturero José Antonio Morales, también fue capturado.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: El Rastro cumple 10 años revelando crímenes reales, mentes criminales e impactantes investigaciones. A través de 117 episodios, el programa ha marcado la TV colombiana con historias estremecedoras y casos que retan la imaginación.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: La muerte de Diana Marcela es el resultado de una historia de celos, pasion, traicion que destruyen a toda una familia. Tras las investigaciones de la fiscalía a causa del homicidio, se destapan secretos que sorprenden a la familia, vecinos y pareja de la víctima.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Los Wilson demandan a Sean Moore, patrocinador de Ballpark Bandits, por 10.000 dólares. Su hijo fue despedido a mitad de temporada, Sean culpa al comportamiento errático de Kevin y a Laurie por fomentar la negatividad e intimidar a los padres.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Samantha demanda a Elizabeth y al investigador privado Ricardo por 40.000 dólares por acusaciones falsas. Elizabeth contrató a Ricardo para investigar al marido de Samantha, pero acusó erróneamente a Samantha. Samantha denuncia acoso y difamación. Elizabeth y Ricardo niegan responsabilidad.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Jennifer Lozada, de 46 años, demanda a su esposo y a su amante por enajenación de afecto.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Michelle está demandando a Michael y Nuri por negligencia y pérdida comercial después de que su spa de alta gama se dañó cuando los lechones de Michael y Nuri fueron liberados y se volvieron locos en su negocio.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Annie demanda a su ex mejor amiga Olivia por 150.000 dólares de angustia emocional. Olivia, una vez dama de honor, secuestró los planes de boda, cambiando de lugar y de vestidos. Annie se siente traicionada y retira a Olivia de la fiesta nupcial. Olivia se defiende, dice que mejoró la boda.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Ángela Tristancho enfrenta la brutal pérdida de su hija Ángela Lucía, asesinada por su joven vecino sordo. Dos años después, la justicia sigue sin llegar debido a retrasos legales.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Omar Carmona, quien preparó el cadáver de Escobar, revela detalles de su muerte y las amenazas recibidas. Tras 27 años, la tumba de Escobar sigue siendo un lugar de peregrinación.

programme.title: Maury
programme.sub-title: ¿Mi prometido me engañó con más de 50 mujeres y mi mejor amigo?
programme.desc: ¿El prometido de Tiffany dejó embarazada a su mejor amiga lesbiana? ¡Don y Amy vuelven para otra prueba de detector de mentiras! ¡Esta vez Don quiere saber si Amy se acuesta con su hermano! ¿Lograrán aprobar la prueba?

programme.title: Maury
programme.sub-title: Mi esposa me engañó con tres hombres… ¿Soy el padre de su bebé?
programme.desc: Larry niega al bebé de Emaginae por ser niño de mamá. Lisa insiste que él no es el padre. Dwayne busca saber si es papá del bebé de Emily y si Randy es su padre. Mientras, Tim sospecha que su esposa Ariell lo engaña.

programme.title: Arriba las manos Texano (1969)

A medida que sus caminos se cruzan, ambos descubren una pasión compartida por la justicia y la verdad, emprendiendo un viaje que pondrá a prueba sus ideales y los llevará hacia un destino incierto.

programme.title: Con el diablo en el cuerpo (1954)
programme.desc: Tras creer que ha cometido un asesinato, Lucio Márquez huye y se refugia en el rancho de su hermano Fausto, un hombre honorable. Allí, Lucio pone a prueba la relación de su hermano al enamorarse de su prometida. Dividida entre dos hombres, ella deberá tomar una decisión cuyas consecuencias podrían ser fatales.

programme.title: Reverendo Colt (2024)
programme.desc: El reverendo Miller llega a Tucson donde quiere construir una iglesia, pero el mismo día de su llegada, una banda lleva a cabo una redada en el banco y la gente de Tucson, que sospechan del nuevo reverendo porque lleva un arma, le culpan inmediatamente del robo.

programme.title: El desierto pintado (2022)

programme.title: El hombre que mató a Billy el Niño (1967)

programme.desc: Mark has once again taken Allysa under his wing and is teaching her the finer points of installing a grill and headlights on our 1972 Duster, meanwhile George is in the body shop attaching a tricky quarter panel to a 1969 ‘Cuda which Mark has to check off the list…military style? Finally, the Duster gets it’s drive train and is finally reunited with its engine.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Who better to explain the history and discuss the changes, year to year, of the Dodge Charger, than the Master of Mopar himself, Mark Worman. In this special episode of Graveyard Carz, Mark will show you unique differences, surprising insights, and cool features on multiple years of the same car: the Dodge Charger.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The focus has shifted, with parts having arrived at the shop it’s time to install the Grill, Bumper, Dash and Interior of our 1968 Turbine Bronze Charger. Mark and the Ghouls work their magic on the Charger until a familiar face shows up. With Royal there, Mark shifts the crew back to the 1 of 2 1970 Coronet and finishes the interior. Then, it’s time for a test drive!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.sub-title: Willie, Paint it Black? - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With SEMA 2018 looming on the horizon, it’s time to address the elephant in the room. Mark’s 1964 A100 Hemi truck, the Little Dead Wagon, built as an homage to Bill Maverick’s Little Red Wagon. Will is set to prime and paint, but has a disagreement with Mark over the color. When the engine for the A100 shows up it’s time to unbox one of the most powerful engines Graveyard Carz has ever put in a car!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark and the Ghouls get down to work like never before in order to get the A100 ready for SEMA which is only weeks away. Brakes, suspension, tail lights, bed sealer, you name it and the Mopar Maniacs are racing to get it done. With time flying and stress mounting the team works long hours and weekends trying to finish this iconic build. With SEMA only days away, the A100 finally gets it’s iconic 426 HEMI engine, well, if they can make it fit!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.sub-title: Night of the Little Dead Wagon - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: There is no time left, SEMA is almost here but the iconic A100 still needs some buttoning up. Installing all of the final components is an all hands on deck task and when the dust settles, Mark has only the decals left to put on the car, completing its legendary look. With the A100 finished the team heads out to SEMA in order to roll the Little Dead Wagon over the red carpet for Mopar and Mark once again receives a very kind gift from our friends.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: When Mark get’s started talking about a car there is almost no stopping him. So it is again when Mark picks multiple years of a favorite Mopar of his and tells both the audience, and whoever will listen all about their amazing options and cool differences. The Ghouls join in on the fun just like last time to pick their favorite things as well. Don’t worry, though, he can’t talk forever right?

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.sub-title: Duster In The Wind - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With SEMA over the Ghoulz can finally rest and get back to work on all the cars they had to leave untouched for the last few weeks…again. First up on deck is our beautiful 1972 Duster. Needing it’s Dash installed as well as it’s interior there is still a lot of work left on this car! Additionally, metal work has begun on a host of new cars moving up through the shop, it never stops at Graveyard Carz.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 201
programme.desc: An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 202
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 203
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 204
programme.desc: Dale searches for priceless motorcycles to bring to the Vegas auction.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 205
programme.desc: The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 206
programme.desc: The Senior Vice President at Home Depot, Gordon Erickson at is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hard-ware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 207
programme.desc: Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concourse have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, non Harley or Indian machines.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 208
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

This pivotal pool play match is part of the fourth regional of the season, with teams vying for crucial seeding and a bid to the National Championship.The episode showcases intense action, starting with Women's Doubles, where UVA's Armelle Worrell and Mia Kim face off against Virginia Tech's Amelia Gaze and Heather Murphy. programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Madre e hija disputan hijo; Misma casa 4 inquilinos desalojados
programme.desc: Karla quedó embarazada de su padrastro, al parir le dejó el bebé a su madre y ahora ella no se lo quiere devolver. Pilar le exige a Tania desalojar la casa que le alquiló antes de que la destruya.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Niña insatisfecha con su vagina; Anchón ayudando a otros niños
programme.desc: Una niña de 14 años tiene la vagina deformada; insatisfecha, quiere autorización para operársela y lucir mejor. Una madre no deja que su hijo autista ayude a niños con cáncer; Ignacio la amenaza.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Perdí papeles por sexo; Atleta golpea esposa
programme.desc: Johnny fue despedido por no complacer el acoso sexual de su jefa; ahora exige una compensación. Ignacio golpeó a su esposa, lo grabaron y publicaron el video; él demanda a quien lo hizo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: La hija de la mula; Testamento infame
programme.desc: Helen se niega a darle la residencia en EE. UU. a su hija; el papá de la niña, Felipe, la demanda para obligarla. América pide emanciparse porque descubrió que su madrastra es la amante de su hermano.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Donación post mortem para arte; La lucha por Sabrina
programme.desc: Una artista dona su cadáver para exponerlo en una galería de arte, pero su marido Luciano intenta impedirlo. Luis quiere quitarle la custodia de su hermana con síndrome de Down a su enfermera Libia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Marian exige que Gary interne a su hermana, pero él alega que Emily solo necesita unión familiar. A Karla le traumatizaba el tráfico, quiso cambiar de horario y fue despedida; ahora exige una compensación.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Dúo de magia; Hija con cáncer y embarazada
programme.desc: Un mago quiere desalojar a su aprendiz por revelar muchos trucos. Una adolescente está embarazada, pero tiene cáncer. Sus padres debaten si salvar la vida del futuro bebé o la de su hija.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Paulina enviudó y se casó con Franco. Pero el esposo de Paulina reapareció y ahora Franco los demanda. Federico es minusválido y sufre de erecciones. Elizabeth se aprovechó y se embarazó, pero ahora Federico reclama al bebé.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Hijo de mi hermano no; Luchadora para salvar hijo
programme.desc: Raquel necesita ser parte de la vida de su hijo con Roberto, pero este dice que no porque el niño es producto de un incesto. Tania es una ex luchadora que quiere volver al ring, pero su hijo se opone.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Papaya y pepino; Golpe por golpe
programme.desc: Un hombre le da educación sexual a dos niñas con vegetales; una madre lo denuncia. La esposa de una de las víctimas de un juego mortal demanda al agresor de su marido por 50 mil dólares.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Amenazas por Facebook; Esposa millonaria vieja
programme.desc: David subió un video en Facebook donde dice que va a matar a su amiga; piden una orden de alejamiento. Camilo quiere sacar a su mujer de la casa y quedarse con la sirvienta que se ganó la lotería.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Depredador injusto; Padre stripper, scary boyfriend
programme.desc: María le exige a su marido que desaloje a su hermano por ser un depredador sexual, ella teme por su niña. Un padre acusa a la madre de su hijo de ser drogadicta y pide la patria potestad.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Cocaína para pre eyaculación; Legalización venta de órganos
programme.desc: Camilo usa cocaína como remedio para su eyaculación precoz; la esposa denuncia que la drogó. Un padre quiere comprar un riñón en Irán para su hija, pero la madre demanda que se lo prohíban.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Hijo preso por defender a novia; Lesbianas odian a los hombres
programme.desc: El hijo de Melba está preso en Colombia por defender a su novia; la mamá pide que ella lo ayude. Mario quiere quitarle su hija a Elly, alega que ella la contamina con odio hacia los hombres.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Youtube reina del toilet; Se inyecta pene
programme.desc: Un hombre planea convertir a su esposa en "la reina del toilet". Elizabeth, su suegra, pide una orden de alejamiento. Iván se inyecta un medicamento en el pene para más potencia; su esposa quiere el divorcio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: La chismosa de la farándula; Esposo cojo, esposa asexual
programme.desc: La Pitonisa exige una orden de alejamiento por agresión contra la cantante Nati. Pedro quiere divorciarse de Ana, quien alega ser asexual. Pedro asegura que ella lo rechaza porque le falta una pierna.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El barbero del bichote; Riñón por virginidad
programme.desc: Nathaniel le exige a Medi que le devuelva la custodia de su sobrino. Carla le dona un riñón al hombre que ama a cambio de que le quite su virginidad. Ahora la esposa demanda a la donante.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Con leucemia entrega hija; Casanova persa
programme.desc: John exige la custodia de la hija que su hermano, preso, tuvo con Franchesca, quien sufre leucemia. Daniela solicita extender la orden de alejamiento para Hamed porque la agredió varias veces.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Rumpólogo: Lectura de nalga; Sugar Daddy de universidad
programme.desc: Nataly va a que le predigan el futuro a través de sus nalgas; su esposo no lo tolera y solicita la custodia del niño que tienen en común. Jorge se llevó a Evelyn a su casa, pero ahora pide su desalojo; ella quiere una compensación.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Musulmán discriminado - ISIS; Ayuda para Ana
programme.desc: Eduardo, musulmán, fue despedido por defender a los terroristas de ISIS. Ahora solicita 100 mil dólares de indemnización. Carol teme que Ana se suicide y exige que la internen en un psiquiátrico.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Exnovia mando 77 mil txt msgs; Mamá dona riñón con tumor
programme.desc: Leopoldo demanda una orden de alejamiento para Paula, su exnovia, porque lo acosa. Karla espera incapacitar a su mamá, quien es diabética y va a donarle un riñón a su novio menor que ella.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Abuela toma baños de luna; Grupo oro sólido
programme.desc: Yuri quiere que alejen a Ana de su abuela de 87 años porque la induce a fumar marihuana. La bailarina Lina intenta anular un contrato con Felipe, ya que él pretende que ella baile desnuda.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Esposo chavista; Ayuda para hermana de crianza
programme.desc: Edgar es antichavista y no acepta que su exmujer se lleve a su hija a Venezuela con su nuevo esposo chavista. Shariz le exige a Hilda que busque ayuda para su hermana de crianza, Nayla.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El embarque de Luisa; Joven sin ganas de vivir
programme.desc: Lázaro le hizo una promesa a San Lázaro y ahora se viste como el santo, por eso Luisa se va a divorciar. Martín tiene una enfermedad terminal y piensa quitarse la vida; su madre pide que lo salven.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Mónica exige anular un contrato que firmó con Ricardo, su ex yerno, y con su hija. Mónica se prestó para ser madre subrogada, pero ahora su hija y su yerno se separaron y Mónica quiere abortar a la criatura.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El órgano que nunca tuve; Gusano come carne
programme.desc: Juan nació sin miembro viril. Aunque pudo casarse, quiere injertarse un pene. Cristina exige una indemnización por la muerte de su esposo, quien murió a causa de un gusano que se come la piel.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Niño nena de mamá; Mamá, paga por tu abandono
programme.desc: Un niño que se siente mujer desde su nacimiento decidió tomar hormonas femeninas para iniciar su cambio de sexo. Magdalena fue abandonada por su mamá y demanda 18 mil dólares de manutención.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El vampireso; 10 años sin ver a papá
programme.desc: Alondra exige terapia psicológica para su esposo Luis, quien está obsesionado con una famosa llamada Vampy. María pide que su madre le permita hablar con su padre, a quien daba por muerto.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Cristina le exige 10 mil dólares a su esposo, Alejandro, por abuso sexual. Saúl intenta obligar a Alejandra a que le permita usar sus ahorros para que su suegra tenga una muerte asistida.

programme.desc: Leonor acepta la propuesta de Omar de convertirse en la señora Terán. Rivero no cree que el agente de la DEA asesinó a Andrews, mientras Morán le dice a Tim que él y los Casillas lo mataron.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Doña Alba amenaza con un arma a Aurelio, y él le pide que lo mate de una vez. Ella no dispara y llama a Feyo para decirle que se cuide. Omar miente, le asegura a Leonor que no conoce a Mónica.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Feyo y Aurelio llegan a Cancún listos para matar. Rutila le confiesa a Rivero que el Chema es el padre de su hijo, y le pide que lo asesine. Begoña consigue drogas en el cuarto de Luciana.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica le revela a Víctor que Aurelio es culpable de la muerte de Isabel y sus hijos, pero él desespera y no quiere creerlo. Feyo acusa a Casillas de soplón, pero dejan su enfrentamiento para luego.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor culpa a Aurelio de la muerte de Chabela y se van a los golpes: le dice a su tío que está con Mónica, que no se atreva a hacerle daño. Feyo y el Chema se asocian y van contra Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Junto a Esperanza, Aurelio se decide por el lavado de dinero y le deja el narcotráfico a Víctor; además, no perdona a Mónica por revelar su secreto. Cristina venderá información de Casillas a Ignacio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: A woman vanishes in Oregon, leaving her infant daughter behind. The woman's husband is behaving suspiciously--but he has an airtight alibi and there is no physical evidence of a crime. The case stalls until detectives begin working with psychic Laurie McQuary, who helps uncover the plot behind the woman's disappearance. A single California mother disappears after a night out with friends. Her family begins a desperate search to find her and bring her home. When hope turns to despair, a random phone call from psychic Donielle Patton helps police deliver justice.

programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: An elderly couple is shot in their upstate New York home - no witnesses, no apparent motive. Detectives struggle to develop suspects, but without evidence to tie their suspects to the killing, their investigation stalls. The case gets a boost when psychic Noreen Renier confirms the investigators' suspicions, and even leads them to a new clue. Halfway across the country, the sudden disappearance of a young mother shocks a small Ohio town. The woman's husband - a cop - claims she left him, but her parents and police aren't so sure. Psychic Georgia Rudolph helps lead police to the truth.

programme.title: Episodio 111 (2026)
programme.desc: Wilker y Yubiri se besan como les exigen en la película pero ellos se besan de verdad y cuando dicen corten | ellos siguen besándose. Intervienen entonces Briggite y Juan Diego. Lolita trata de convencer a Solymar que lo que es del cura va para la iglesia. Freddy se burla de Yubiri por lo del beso. Briggite llega y también le dice que terminó siendo una gran actriz Carolina y Juan Diego tienen una gran discusión. Ella le reclama que haya dicho corte por el megáfono.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Sofía continúa haciendo todo lo posible por lograr que Agustín y Magdalena se divorcien, ya que lo quiere solamente para ella. Esta vez, lo emborracha y lo convence de pasar la noche juntos. Agustín no vuelve a su casa hasta el otro día, cuando pone la excusa de que ha tenido que dormir solo en un hotel. Gabriel empieza a darse cuenta de la gravedad de su enfermedad y se emociona hablando con Gloria de los viejos tiempos en que los dos junto con Epicúreo eran inseparables. Está dispuesto a hacer todo con tal de no morirse a causa de su problema en los riñones. Maikel está cansado de la mentira de su tío a Valentina, está cansado de que lo vean como una persona que no es. Es por eso que, aparentemente, puede llegar a decir toda la verdad que Epicúreo tiene tan bien guardada.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia, gravemente enferma, pide ser enterrada con su vestido de novia y Ricardo promete casarse con ella al día siguiente. Mientras tanto, Manuela intenta mediar en el conflicto entre Ricardo, Misael y Glorita. René y Gustavo son arrestados tras un altercado, y Katiuska muestra su desprecio hacia la servidumbre. A pesar de su fiebre alta, Celia se niega a ir al médico y prefiere pasear con su familia para que todos los vean unidos antes de partir.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Carlos logra que Junior reaccione tras el desmayo. Adolfo y Consuelo revelan a Rosa que su matrimonio debe anularse porque Junior es su hermano; ella confiesa que el hijo es de Alejandro. Blanca enfrenta a Arminda por haberle ocultado el paradero de Rosa toda la vida. Junior reclama a Marisela haberle ocultado la gravedad de su enfermedad. Erasto irrumpe en su casa al ver a Blanca y la amenaza, pero ella le anuncia que peleará por sus tierras. Rosa jura que siempre considerará a Carmen Rosa como su única madre y nunca dejará a Junior solo.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Milagros y Enzo están en el ascensor y mientras ella cuenta para que él lo haga andar él le quita los documentos de la cartera para que ella tenga que volver a verlo. Vicky está enojada porque vio a Enzo besándose con Milagros. Él trata de compensarla llevándola al club, pero cuando ella se va a la habitación él se escapa para la empresa para volver a ver a Milagros, quien va a buscar sus documentos. Augusto revisa a María Gracia y no encuentra ninguna herida, por lo que le dice que está bien.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor

programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders (2023)

programme.desc: loudQUIETloud follows the rehearsals and the warm-up shows for the full-fledged, sold-out Pixies reunion tour. The Pixies have a once-in-a-lifetime chance at rock n roll redemption.

programme.title: Until The Light Takes Us (2023)
programme.desc: Until The Light Takes Us tells the story of black metal. Part music scene and part cultural uprising, black metal rose to worldwide notoriety in the mid-nineties when a rash of suicides, murders, and church burnings accompanied the explosive artistic growth and output of a music scene that would forever redefine what heavy metal is and what it stands for.

programme.sub-title: A Teen Girl Obsessed With Her Ex
programme.desc: A teen girl so obsessed with her on-again, off-again boyfriend that he claims she has become a stalker, forcing him to get a restraining order… for three years! Cristie says her 19-year-old daughter Corryn started dating 17-year-old Jack almost two years ago and every time they break up, Corryn becomes a “crazy ex-girlfriend.” Jack claims Corryn calls him hundreds of times a day, breaks into his house and hides behind the bushes to watch his every move, each time violating the restraining order. But Corryn says Jack plays games with her and lures her to him every time. Cristie and Jack’s mom, Brytt, say they’ve had it and want their teens’ relationship to end today -- but what does Corryn have to say about that? Can she stop obsessing over Jack, and will she keep a promise she made to Dr. Phil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Some believe self-censorship is a big problem today, particularly in light of the idea that someone can be "canceled" for their words -- blocked from having a prominent public platform or career for sharing their opinion. Dr. Phil interviews Nate, a former Idaho police officer, who claims he was fired after making a TikTok video about NBA superstar LeBron James that went viral and has been viewed over 4 million times. Nate explains how the fall-out from the video affected him and his family, too. Dr. Phil also speaks with conservative political commentator Tomi Lahren, who says she recently had to be protected by state police from student protestors at the University of New Mexico. Greg Lukianoff, president of the Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression, says he believes Americans have lost the ability to discuss their differences rationally. And, Dr. Shaun Harper, founder and Executive Director of the USC Race and Equity Center, says he is firmly against hate speech and feels people need to be more mindful about the effects of their words.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: You Said It, Now You’re Canceled! Pt 2
programme.desc: The “self-censorship” debate continues. Meet Alejandro, a student who claims administrators at his community college violated his free speech rights. He says when he and members of the club Young Americans for Freedom posted flyers on campus, they were censored. Then, which public figures are fighting back against cancel culture? And, Dr. Phil takes a closer look at a list of terms that are now allegedly off limits. What words are on that list? Tune in to find out.

Walt was initially tried for the murder, but the case was dismissed after the trial resulted in a hung jury -- and he says Rachel needs to stop pointing the finger at him and move on. Tensions run high when Rachel confronts Walt on Dr. Phil’s stage. Where was Walt the night of Lori’s death? And, how does he explain allegations that he has made inconsistent statements to police? Then, Walt says he passed a polygraph in 1985, clearing his name. Dr. Phil calls on polygraph expert Jack Trimarco to examine the results -- what are his thoughts? programme.desc: This Dr. Phil Family is angry, out of control, and about to get an intervention in The Dr. Phil House. Melissa, 22, wrote to Dr. Phil for help for her self-destructive family. Her mother, Myra, and her stepfather, Gene, have a long history of betrayals, infidelity, anger and years of bitter resentment. Melissa says her family even turns special occasions into volatile disasters with turkey dinners and Christmas trees being thrown across the room. The fighting got so bad, Melissa says she had to move away from her extreme family. Her brothers, Edwin, 20, and Eugene, 17, attest that their home is a war zone, and that they have witnessed fights between their parents that involve name-calling, spitting and dousing each other with water, all in front of their 7-year-old brother. Myra says she can’t forgive Gene for his four affairs, but especially the last one, which was with a 19-year-old. Over three years have passed since Gene’s last affair, but Myra still calls him a pedophile every chance she gets, and says she’d leave if it weren’t for their youngest child. Can this family learn to stop the drama, heal their anger and start over with a healthy foundation, or should they call it quits for good?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Every day, many teen girls fear for their lives because of obsessive, controlling and abusive boyfriends, and it’s another reason why Dr. Phil is so passionate about his campaign to End the Silence on Domestic Violence. Seventeen-year-old Samantha sent an urgent plea for help to Dr. Phil. She says her ex-boyfriend, Aaron, called her nonstop for weeks and sent her threatening text messages after she broke up with him. After Samantha changed her number, he began calling her mother repeatedly. Samantha says he showed up unannounced at her house and pounded on the door for 45 minutes while she cowered in a locked closet. She says she’s afraid Aaron could even kill her. programme.desc: Do you worry your teen daughter could throw away everything she's worked for - all for young love? programme.desc: Bored Tokyo lady Setsuko (Independent Spirit Award-nominee Shinobu Terajima) breaks free of her monotonous life when her niece, Mika (Shioli Kutsuna) convinces her to enroll in an unorthodox English class. There, she adopts a blonde-haired alter ego name 'Lucy' and develops romantic feelings for her American instructor, John (Josh Hartnett).But after his sudden disappearance, Setsuko follows his trail halfway around the world to Southern California, where family ties and past lives are tested as she struggles to fulfill the promise of 'Lucy.'

programme.title: Pushing Hands [English Subtitle] (2025)
programme.desc: Having just moved from Beijing, elderly tai chi master Mr. Chu (Sihung Lung) struggles to adjust to life in New York, living with his Americanized son Alex (Ye-tong Wang). Chu immediately butts heads with his put-upon white daughter-in-law, Martha (Deb Snyder), a writer who seems to blame him for her own paralyzing inability to focus. But when Chu begins teaching tai chi at a local school, his desire to make a meaningful connection comes to fruition in the most unexpected of ways. PUSHING HANDS is the debut film from Oscar-winning director Ang Lee, forming the first chapter in his 'Father Knows Best' trilogy, which depicts the tensions between the traditional Confucian values of the older generation and the realities of modern life. Co-written by collaborator James Schamus, PUSHING HANDS was selected by the 1992 Berlin International Film Festival and won three Golden Horse Awards, paving the way for Lee's worldwide success with films such as CROUCHING TIGER, HIDDEN DRAGON and BROKEBACK MOUNTAIN. Presented in a new 2K restoration.

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E03 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E03 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: At the dinner, the main topic will be Rosa Blanco. Ezequiel says that this woman was an opportunist who fell in love with and took advantage of his younger brother, Leoncio. Astrid offends by adding that she was a prostitute, guilty of the war between the two families because of her relationship with Augusto Aragón and also with Leoncio López.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila insists on knowing about her family relationship, she thinks she could be Max's cousin. Camila protects Chantal, a girl who sells flowers.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje

programme.desc: Roberto asks Astrid to get him a job at Mascarada in exchange for not doing anything against Max. Camila confesses to Max that Roberto is blackmailing her. Luciano and the inspector question Mother Isabel and Father Tiziano about Rosa Blanco and they lie.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila fiercely defends herself from Roberto's aggression and tells Max what happened. Mother Isabel, to help Camila, confides to Ezequiel why Roberto is extorting her. Max pressures Camila to tell him the whole truth.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Roberto confesses that he was the one who killed Gabriel to frame Camila. Camila cries with joy, knowing she is innocent of that death. Max reiterates his unconditional support, ratifying his great love for her. Ezequiel expresses his intention to marry Camila.
