programme.title: Knebworth Documentary (2026)
programme.desc: Liam Gallagher revisits Oasis' defining performance. The film features interviews, behind the scenes, and concert footage from over 20 camera positions.

programme.title: Bob Dylan: Shadow Kingdom (2026)
programme.desc: Bob Dylan performs early songs in an intimate 2021 concert film, delivering reimagined classics like Forever Young and It’s All Over Now, Baby Blue.

programme.title: GHOST: Rite Here Rite Now (2023)
programme.desc: Filmed during the GRAMMY-winning rock band’s sold-out RE-IMPERATOUR finale at the Kia Forum in Los Angeles, Rite Here Rite Now fuses blistering live performance with a haunting cinematic narrative. Led by Papa Emeritus IV and his nameless ghouls, Ghost delivers theatrical rock anthems, eerie storytelling, and striking visuals in this immersive concert film. Combining songs like “Spillways,” “Call Me Little Sunshine,” and “Watcher in the Sky” with a supernatural storyline, the film captures the band’s balance of grandeur, satire, and devotion to spectacle. Includes an exclusive Q&A with Tobias Forge, Alex Ross Perry, and Jim Parsons from the London premiere.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.sub-title: Morgan Lander of Kittie on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Morgan Lander, frontwoman of Canadian heavy metal band Kittie, joins Joel Madden to discuss breaking into the metal scene as teenage girls, reclaiming power in a male-dominated industry, and redefining success on their own terms. Lander reflects on burnout, body autonomy, and growing up in the spotlight before returning stronger than ever.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: De'Wayne discusses identity and growth with Joel, touching on Lenny Kravitz, arenas, and the garage.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.sub-title: Tim Kasher of Cursive on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Nebraska-born singer, songwriter, and director Tim Kasher, frontman of Cursive, joins Joel Madden to discuss nearly 30 years of indie rock evolution, the band’s new album Devourer, and finding meaning in creative longevity. The two explore the role of art, relevancy, and gratitude as artists grow older and stay inspired.

programme.title: Sarah Barthel on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Sarah Barthel—singer, songwriter, and one half of platinum duo Phantogram—for a candid conversation about using art to process emotion, the band’s obsessive pursuit of a singular sound, and the lifelong creative bond between Sarah and bandmate Josh Carter. They trace Phantogram’s beginnings (from beat tapes to breakthrough), balancing romance and partnership, channeling real-life heartbreak into “When I’m Small,” coping with family loss, and gearing up for a summer tour with Deftones. Cameos of warmth (including Leroy the dog) and plenty of shop talk on writing, producing, and performing.

programme.title: Shakira: El Dorado World Tour (2026)
programme.desc: After El Dorado, Shakira returns with her most acclaimed tour, performing Chantaje and La Bicicleta alongside hits from her 20+ year career in sold-out venues worldwide. Tras El Dorado, regresa con su gira más elogiada.

programme.title: a-ha: True North (2026)
programme.desc: 90km above the Arctic Circle, Norway's very own a-ha recorded their first collection of music since 2015's Cast in Steel. "True North is a letter from a-ha, from the Arctic Circle, a poem from the far north of Norway," says Magne Furuholmen. Accompanied by a film, the conceptual collection combines the band's visions and the talent of Norwegian orchestra, Arctic Philharmonic.

programme.title: Say Anything: Is A Real Boy 20th Anniversary Tour Live from Los Angeles (2024)
programme.desc: Say Anything performs ...Is A Real Boy live at The Wiltern, celebrating the album’s 20th anniversary with a special concert event.

programme.title: Subhah Agarwal: Airport Pigeon (2025)
programme.desc: Subhah Agarwal delivers a deeply personal stand-up special on mental health, blending sharp humor with stories on rock bottom moments, resilience, and unexpected perspectives.

programme.title: Comedian CP: Sunday After Six (2026)
programme.desc: Known for his sharp wit and fearless storytelling, Comedian CP (Detroiters, Love Life, How to Die Alone) takes the stage in Sunday After Six — a no-holds-barred stand-up special that dives into fatherhood, relationships, race, and the kind of real-life moments you couldn’t make up. From awkward encounters to wild imagination, CP’s offbeat humor and unfiltered honesty make every punchline land harder than the last.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.sub-title: Jakob Nowell of Sublime on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Jakob Nowell, frontman of Sublime and Jakob’s Castle, joins Joel Madden for an open conversation on legacy, sobriety, and finding identity beyond fame. Jakob reflects on growing up surrounded by music, his father’s influence, building his own sound, and the healing power of honesty in art.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: In this introspective episode, Ricky Hil — rapper, designer, and son of fashion icon Tommy Hilfiger — opens up to Joel Madden about his lifelong connection to music and streetwear, his battles with addiction, and his journey toward self-understanding. Ricky reflects on his creative independence, the lessons learned from his father, and finding peace through art after years of struggle. The conversation dives deep into authenticity, identity, and the healing power of creativity.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: The Voidz: Tomorrow A Special (2025)
programme.desc: The Voidz perform live in a special TOMORROW! episode, offering an immersive look into their experimental sound and creative world.

programme.desc: In this cult-classic sequel, when the brother of doomed newscaster Karen White, her co-worker and a mysterious stranger (Christopher Lee) set out to save the world from a werewolf invasion, they must first destroy an immortal werewolf queen!

programme.title: Mom (2019)
programme.desc: Most moms are wonderful cooks, this one...likes it raw! Something's been eating Clay Dwyer. His mom! Once a sweet lovable lady, she's been bitten by and transformed into a flesheater, turning her into a hungry creature with a knack for good old homestyle cooking. What is Clay to do? To everyone else she's a monster that must be destroyed. But to him she's still MOM.

programme.title: A Cape Cod Christmas (2024)
programme.desc: Margot, a children’s book author, travels to the family beach house on Cape Cod for one last Christmas with her siblings. With her parents gone, her siblings want to sell. Margot commissions her old friend and local artist, Christian, to paint a picture of the house as a keepsake. But Christian is a painter of much greater renown than Margot realizes, and they hatch a plan to keep the house she loves.

programme.title: My Christmas Prince (2017)
programme.desc: Samantha, a dedicated teacher, heads home for Christmas with her boyfriend Alex, whom she believes is a diplomat. But holiday cheer turns to royal chaos when she discovers he’s actually the heir to the throne of Madelvia. With his disapproving royal parents and her own dreams on the line, Samantha must decide if love is worth giving up everything she’s worked for to become a queen.

programme.title: Jingle Belle (2026)
programme.desc: Every year, high school sweethearts Isabelle and Mike delighted their small town with a Christmas duet at the annual Christmas Eve Pageant. After graduation, Isabelle left for Juilliard, leaving Mike behind. Years later, she returns home to write music for the beloved pageant and discovers Mike is directing the show. As old feelings resurface, they must put the past behind them and decide if they can make beautiful music together again.

programme.title: Sharing Christmas (2017)
programme.desc: A real estate developer gets the chance of a lifetime to transform an old shopping complex into a luxury hotspot. But his plans hit a snag when the last holdout is the charming owner of a year-round Christmas shop—someone he unexpectedly connected with just days earlier. As he tries to win her over professionally, he finds himself falling for her and questioning everything he thought he wanted.

programme.title: My Christmas Prince (2017)
programme.desc: Samantha, a dedicated teacher, heads home for Christmas with her boyfriend Alex, whom she believes is a diplomat. But holiday cheer turns to royal chaos when she discovers he’s actually the heir to the throne of Madelvia. With his disapproving royal parents and her own dreams on the line, Samantha must decide if love is worth giving up everything she’s worked for to become a queen.

programme.title: A Merry Single Christmas (2022)
programme.desc: Morgan has lost her Christmas spirit after breaking up with her long time boyfriend, Liam. She decides to go to a retreat called The Christmas Lonely Hearts Club where she hopes to rekindle her Christmas spirit. Things seem to be going well until her Ex shows up. Morgan and Liam will have to conceal their previous relationship while trying to discover what it means to be single. What they don’t realize is that adhering to the “no romance” policy might require a Christmas miracle.

programme.title: Christmas on Repeat (2022)
programme.desc: An ad executive, overwhelmed by work, is granted a magical do-over of the holidays by Santa. As she relives the same festive days, she begins to recognize how much time she’s missed with her family. Through the repeating moments, she learns to slow down, cherish loved ones, and find balance between career and personal life. The story highlights the importance of connection, presence, and appreciating the people who matter most.

programme.title: A Christmas Cruise (2024)
programme.desc: A single, successful writer decides to do double duty when her best friend invites her on a Christmas Cruise and decides to see if finding true love during the holidays can really happen or will it be just another holiday story.

programme.title: My Best Friends Christmas (2024)
programme.desc: When Ashley Seever returns home for the holidays hoping to reconnect with her high school sweetheart Grant, she soon meets his new girlfriend. In an attempt to escape the embarrassment, she and her best friend Liam fake their own holiday romance…but when her fake feelings for Liam start to turn real, Ashley will have to choose what her heart really wants this Christmas.

programme.title: Dognapped: Hound for the Holidays (2022)
programme.desc: When egotistical social media influencer DD Ward's dog is shockingly kidnapped, her long-suffering and under-appreciated assistant Emily forms an alliance with a down to earth local veterinarian to find the puppy before Christmas. As the two investigate all possible suspects, the duo form an unbreakable relationship that just might lead them to become more than partners as they find their own puppy love.

programme.title: The Search for Secret Santa (2022)
programme.desc: Cub reporter Sophia thinks she's found a Christmas story that will save her career when she discovers a long-lost, undelivered Secret Santa gift. Trying to uncover and bring closure to the overdue present before Christmas, Sophia discovers much more than she could have hoped for when she discovers that the gift is not only priceless but stolen.

programme.title: The Case of the Christmas Diamond (2022)
programme.desc: When New York City lawyer Julia Crawley returns to her Rocky Mountain hometown and her family’s lovely inn for the holidays, she finds herself at the center of a generations-old feud with the family that runs the town’s other inn. As the ongoing competition between the two inns escalates, “forbidden” romance blossoms between Julia and Roger Mason, whose family runs the inn that is her family’s big competitor.

programme.title: The Tree That Saved Christmas (2023)
programme.desc: Struggling writer Annie Logan is devasted to learn that she won't be able to go home to the family tree farm in time for Christmas due to the demands of her high-powered boss. But when the tree farm is threatened with closure, Annie bids her life in New York goodbye and rushes home to save the place she has always called home.

programme.title: My Christmas Inn (2026)
programme.desc: With Christmas in full swing, Jen is on the verge of a major promotion at her San Francisco ad agency when she unexpectedly inherits a cozy inn in Alaska. Traveling north to inspect the property, she meets charming local attorney Brian and discovers a welcoming town filled with festive traditions. As she embraces the magic of the season, Jen begins to wonder if the inn—and a new romance—might offer the life she's been searching for.

programme.title: A Very Charming Christmas Town (2020)
programme.desc: When lifestyle blogger Aubrey Lang visits the Danish-settled Californian village of Solvang for her big holiday piece, she at first believes the town is simply a tourist trap. But when Aubrey meets handsome community coordinator and chocolate shop owner Sawyer, to show her around town, Aubrey soon starts to fall for him and realizes the magic of Solvang's Christmas spirit shines year round.

programme.desc: Enojada por su arresto, una mujer se vuelve combativa con los oficiales. Arrestada nuevamente por drogas, una joven inteligente sabe que está tomando malas decisiones, pero no puede dejar de consumir.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Los agentes tienen que intervenir cuando un hombre intenta tragarse su anillo. Un adicto a la heroína busca ayuda cuando se da cuenta de que su adicción le ha costado todo lo que ama.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Ponen a un hombre rencoroso y agresivo en una silla de sujeción. Una mujer ebria recibe una nota de amor de parte de un hombre encarcelado con permiso de trabajo.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre acude a la violencia cuando lo detienen por estar en lugar prohibido. Una mujer de la noche confesa que le oculta a sus clientes que tiene pediculosis. Una mujer explica que sus tatuajes son recuerdos de las mujeres que amó.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Se ordena un registro corporal al desnudo y se descubre a un hombre con ropa interior femenina. Un par de roba-cachorros se tratan amorosamente en el baño. Una mujer embarazada es arrestada por prostitución.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: El capellán de la prisión aconseja a un preso triste. Una mujer ebria exige hablar con la Embajada de Canadá.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Cambian a un hombre peleonero a otra celda. Una mujer transgénero comparte su historia. Un automovilista manejando alocadamente se detiene, y un hombre intoxicado se arresta por agresividad.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre arrestado les canta a los oficiales. Una mujer es acusada de robo. Los oficiales no se dejan engañar por las lágrimas fingidas de una mujer joven.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre es acusado de posesión de una sustancia ilegal. La policía arresta a una mujer con narcóticos y atrapa a una pareja con receta médica falsa.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Se acusa a una mujer de posesión de narcóticos. Una mujer niega haber agredido a su esposo y dos primos agresivos amenazan a la policía y terminan en aislamiento.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un preso no causa gracia con sus payasadas. Una mujer presume sobresalir en la prueba de conducción bajo los efectos del alcohol. Un hombre manejando bajo los efectos del alcohol causa la muerte de un hombre.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Dos presos alborotados terminan en sujeción. Un presunto ladrón se preocupa por una alergia a la leche. Una prisionera se enoja por el cuidado que se les da a sus pertenencias.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una mujer es detenida por atacar a su novio. Un preso que habla mucho es trasladado al aislamiento. Un preso atrevido pelea contra la sujeción e intenta escapar de sus ataduras.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Se descubre que una mujer tiene agujas y que otra tiene una pistola de descarga eléctrica. Una prueba de conducción bajo los efectos del alcohol causa malos recuerdos para un hombre que conduce en estado de ebriedad. Un asesino convicto actúa violentamente.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Se alega que un pasajero agredió a el taxista. Una mujer describe como agredió a su novio con comida caliente. Se arresta a una madre que dejó a sus hijos en el automóvil mientras ella jugaba a las apuestas.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una mujer intenta ocultar sustancias ilegales en su sostén. Unos compañeros de banda reciben una infracción por andar en propiedad prohibida. Después de perder el control, separan y sujetan a dos presos.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un preso restringido e intoxicado logra desatarse. Una joven niega haber abusado de su madre. Un guardia saca a un preso que está causando disturbios.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre indigente intenta resistirse de los oficiales cuando lo llevan a la cárcel, pero después les canta una canción. Un preso dificultoso culpa a varias condiciones médicas por su comportamiento. Una mujer dice que ella es Jesucristo.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una mujer se niega a usar el uniforme de la cárcel. Un hombre cuenta su conmovedora historia a los oficiales, y una mujer ebria que habla mucho se pone en aislamiento.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Sujetan a unos presos escandalosos después de empezar pleitos. Una mujer lucha contra el abuso de sustancias tras la muerte de su prometido. Dos “mujeres de la noche” jóvenes platican de sus estrategias cuando van de casino en casino.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre se preocupa de más por su reloj de $30,000, y después llora cuando le sacan sangre. Una mujer ebria amenaza a los oficiales que la arrestaron con violencia corporal. Una mujer no recuerda cuando la arrestaron.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: El coqueteo de un prisionero calma una pelea en la cárcel. Un hombre ebrio intenta evitar las consecuencias por manejar tomado por octava vez, alegando que le robaron el auto. Una pareja termina en la cárcel por un desacuerdo a causa del Facebook.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una noche de karaoke resulta en un cargo de violencia doméstica. Un preso borracho comienza una pelea con su compañero de celda.
